009@HistoryLogProps(
010    opCode = 229, // -27
011    displayName = "ControlIQ User Mode Change",
012    internalName = "LID_AA_USER_MODE_CHANGE",
013    usedByTidepool = true // LID_AA_USER_MODE_CHANGE
014)
015public class ControlIQUserModeChangeHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
016
017    private int currentUserMode;
018    private int previousUserMode;
019    private int requestedActionRaw;
020    private int sleepStartedByGuiRaw;

025    private int eatingSoonStoppedByTimerRaw;
026
027    public ControlIQUserModeChangeHistoryLog() {}
028    public ControlIQUserModeChangeHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentUserMode, int previousUserMode, int requestedAction, int sleepStartedByGui, int activeSleepSchedule, int exerciseStoppedByTimer, int exerciseChoice, int exerciseTime, int eatingSoonStoppedByTimer) {
029        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
030        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, currentUserMode, previousUserMode, requestedAction, sleepStartedByGui, activeSleepSchedule, exerciseStoppedByTimer, exerciseChoice, exerciseTime, eatingSoonStoppedByTimer);
031        this.currentUserMode = currentUserMode;
032        this.previousUserMode = previousUserMode;
033        this.requestedActionRaw = requestedAction;
034        this.sleepStartedByGuiRaw = sleepStartedByGui;
035        this.activeSleepSchedule = activeSleepSchedule;
036        this.exerciseStoppedByTimerRaw = exerciseStoppedByTimer;
037        this.exerciseChoiceRaw = exerciseChoice;
038        this.exerciseTime = exerciseTime;
039        this.eatingSoonStoppedByTimerRaw = eatingSoonStoppedByTimer;
040
041    }
042
043    public ControlIQUserModeChangeHistoryLog(int currentUserMode, int previousUserMode, int requestedAction, int sleepStartedByGui, int activeSleepSchedule, int exerciseStoppedByTimer, int exerciseChoice, int exerciseTime, int eatingSoonStoppedByTimer) {
044        this(0, 0, currentUserMode, previousUserMode, requestedAction, sleepStartedByGui, activeSleepSchedule, exerciseStoppedByTimer, exerciseChoice, exerciseTime, eatingSoonStoppedByTimer);
045    }

051    /**
052     * <table border="1">
053     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlIQUserModeChangeHistoryLog:</caption>
054     * <tr><td><code>currentUserMode</code></td><td><code>raw[10]</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>previousUserMode</code></td><td><code>raw[11]</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>requestedActionRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>sleepStartedByGuiRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[14]</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>activeSleepSchedule</code></td><td><code>raw[15]</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>exerciseStoppedByTimerRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[18]</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>exerciseChoiceRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[19]</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>exerciseTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 20)</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>eatingSoonStoppedByTimerRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[22]</code></td></tr>
063     * </table>
064     */
065    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
066        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
067        this.cargo = raw;
068        parseBase(raw);
069        this.currentUserMode = raw[10];
070        this.previousUserMode = raw[11];
071        this.requestedActionRaw = raw[12];
072        this.sleepStartedByGuiRaw = raw[14];
073        this.activeSleepSchedule = raw[15];
074        this.exerciseStoppedByTimerRaw = raw[18];
075        this.exerciseChoiceRaw = raw[19];
076        this.exerciseTime = Bytes.readShort(raw, 20);
077        this.eatingSoonStoppedByTimerRaw = raw[22];
078
079    }
080
081    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentUserMode, int previousUserMode, int requestedAction, int sleepStartedByGui, int activeSleepSchedule, int exerciseStoppedByTimer, int exerciseChoice, int exerciseTime, int eatingSoonStoppedByTimer) {
082        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
083            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(229, 0),
084            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
085            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
086            new byte[]{ (byte) currentUserMode },
087            new byte[]{ (byte) previousUserMode },
088            new byte[]{ (byte) requestedAction },
089            new byte[1],
090            new byte[]{ (byte) sleepStartedByGui },
091            new byte[]{ (byte) activeSleepSchedule },
092            new byte[2],
093            new byte[]{ (byte) exerciseStoppedByTimer },
094            new byte[]{ (byte) exerciseChoice },
095            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(exerciseTime),
096            new byte[]{ (byte) eatingSoonStoppedByTimer }));
097    }
098    public int getCurrentUserMode() {
099        return currentUserMode;
100    }
101    public int getPreviousUserMode() {

103    }
